result: {"ratings": {"Omar": {"rating": 4, "why": "He hauled a 40-domino load to the bin, finished the tail tip, and kept clear of my hands, but he mostly watched and cheered from the middle of the round, and his offer to take my bottom line overlapped with work I'd already queued."}, "Hana": {"rating": 4, "why": "I saw her bring two 40-domino loads to the bin and keep it stocked, so nobody ran short, and she correctly pointed out that the bottom line had to wait for the top to reach the nose, though she stayed on supply and never laid a line herself."}, "Jack": {"rating": 5, "why": "He proposed the fish, sketched it on the pad, split the work clearly, laid the top line fast enough that the bottom could start, and checked the nose joint, so the whole fish traced as connected."}}}
